author: Karl Rock
description:
Deep in Sindh, Pakistan, in the middle of the mighty Indus River, lies an extraordinary Hindu temple complex that I never expected to find here.

Sadhu Bela is an island temple dedicated to the Hindu faith, and reaching it meant taking a boat across the Indus River from Sukkur. The island is home to multiple temples, shrines, gardens, living quarters and facilities for devotees who travel here for religious festivals.

But getting there wasn't quite as straightforward as it sounds. As we travelled north through Sindh, the police insisted on accompanying us because of the security situation in the region. Eventually we reached the river, where our only way to the temple was by boat.

Once on the island, I explored Sadhu Bela with the people who live and worship there, including the temple priest who has served here for 20 years.

title: Inside Pakistan’s Hindu Island! | Sadhu Bela
